QuestInfo.0: Yulete returns from meeting with Bedin at the Zenumist Society. Talk to Yulete to see what he's learned.
QuestInfo.1: Yulete returns from meeting with Bedin at the Zenumist Society. Talk to Yulete to see what he's learned.
